{

  "summary": "The hardened REQ-005 candidate is a serious promotion candidate. The conftest import in test_worker.py uses a relative import (`from .conftest import InMemoryDocumentRepository`) which is valid within a test package. An end-to-end SQS integration test class (TestIngestWorkerSqsEndToEnd) is present with two cases covering the full publisher→SQS→consumer→worker chain including idempotent redelivery. The sync-only design is explicitly documented as intentional for a pull-based standalone worker process. The omission of shared/audit is documented and justified. Remaining risks are bounded: async adaptation friction at promotion, absence of a real PostgreSQL integration test, and the settings factory not fully leveraging pydantic-settings env binding. None of these are structural blockers.",
